dataset_name: FitForge AI Indian Food Nutrition Dataset
description: Starter dataset matched to the 100 food image files in the supplied ZIP. Search aliases include English, Hinglish and Marathi names.
nutrition_convention: All macro values are per 100 g edible portion. Per-gram values are derived by dividing by 100. Serving nutrition should be calculated from serving weight, not stored as separate competing values.
important_data_quality_warning: Nutrition numbers are provisional estimates. They have not been individually verified against IFCT 2017 in this generated file. Recipe dishes and homemade preparations vary with ingredient ratios, oil, water and serving size. Verify and standardize before presenting as authoritative health data.

source_references.name: Indian Food Composition Tables 2017
source_references.publisher: National Institute of Nutrition, Indian Council of Medical Research
source_references.use: Preferred primary reference for Indian raw ingredients; map each food to its exact IFCT food code.

source_references.name: Indian Nutrient Databank (INDB)
source_references.use: Potential reference for standardized Indian composite recipes; check licensing and exact recipe match.

nutrition_source.notes: Values in this starter dataset are indicative estimates, not transcribed/verified IFCT laboratory values. Verify against the exact IFCT food code or a standardized recipe before production.
